spectral_dependency.scope: Comparison proof mechanism, explicitly reconstructed for discriminant7 in M7.6-M7.15: all-ideal normalization; norm-one strong approximation; Jacquet-Langlands Theorem14.4 and Proposition5.20; Deligne modular realization and purity. spectral_dependency.application_hypotheses: Maximal order of discriminant7 and projective unit mass1/2 give class number one. Reductions of the two global projective units inject at all odd inert q including3 and at7. At ramified level7 only two norm characters occur; at joint q,7 level all four occur. The Hecke norm bound applies at every index coprime to7 and the added level, including powers of2. Target-dividing inert primes are counted by anisotropic scaling instead of applying a level-prime Hecke estimate.
spectral_dependency.character_scope: Only global one-dimensional automorphic constituents are removed. The direct strong-approximation argument concerns each full smooth local factor, not its level-fixed vector space. Finite right-action characters can remain in the cuspidal complement: at level7 the two quartic C4 characters have T2 eigenvalue1, whereas the two global norm characters have eigenvalue3. The exact norm-two shell and T2=2I+R_[1+j] calculation are written in the proof.
